findings.description: The rotated 32-character chef password is composed with secrets.choice over a 76-character alphabet (os.urandom-backed CSPRNG) and re-drawn until validate_password_policy accepts it; no random module or time-seeded generator appears in the file.

Each of the eight reset-code digits is drawn with secrets.randbelow(10), and the code is persisted only as an HMAC-SHA256 derivation keyed on settings.OTP_HMAC_KEY so the small digit space cannot be precomputed from a stolen table; comparison uses hmac.compare_digest.
